roles.name: Pending User
roles.description: Authenticated but unverified account with no CampusCareer domain access.

roles.name: Student
roles.description: Verified student managing only their own profile, documents, applications, timeline and AI explanations.

roles.name: Employer User
roles.description: Verified employer member restricted to their IAM organization, postings, applicants and outcomes.

roles.name: Career Staff
roles.description: University career-services operator for opportunity approval, application screening and employer follow-up.

roles.name: Career Manager
roles.description: Career-services supervisor for reference data, AI flags, escalations and exceptional corrections.

roles.name: Department Stakeholder
roles.description: Department-scoped placement support and reporting user.

roles.name: University Stakeholder
roles.description: Institution-level aggregate reporting user without routine student-record access.

roles.name: University Superadmin
roles.description: Restricted university administrator for identity, employer organizations, users, roles and access.
